about: Synthetic env/wrapper compatibility cases, not real agent records. Tokens are captured by an owning writer, never backfilled by a reader. Raw ticks deliberately exceed Number's exact integer range.

cases.name: legacy tokenless record remains readable and unknown
matching owned token admits the resident
another boot never admits even with the same pid and ticks
another tick never admits even with the same boot and pid
another pid never admits even with the same boot and ticks
unreadable token never admits even with an identical command line
malformed record token stays readable and unknown
